But we wanted to get a lot of things, and we only got a few items. But, the cashier named Ritesh, his way of speaking is not appropriate. His behavior is completely senseless. He has no idea how to manage or handle customers. His attitude was as if I had bought nothing from the restaurant, just a small snack, even though there are many dishes here. But I request the manager of this restaurant to teach him some manners, how to speak to customers, and how to treat them.

They gave me all bones in the butter chicken too, when it's always been white meat.

review:
Decent food. I ordered chana bhatura, tandoori chicken and fish pakora. None of the dishes stood out, to be honest. It was just average South Asian food. The chana itself was very salty and the tandoori chicken was well seasoned but not especially moist. The fish pakora isn't worth it at all — small fish pieces in a lot of batter. I don't think I'll be getting food from Moti mahal again.
